title: Moving One-Component Regularity Criteria for the 3D Incompressible MHD Equations
summary: We establish a scaling-critical continuation criterion for the three-dimensional incompressible magnetohydrodynamic equations in $\mathbb{R}^3$ with arbitrary positive viscosity and magnetic diffusivity. Let $β(t)$ be a unit vector that is piecewise $H^1$ in time and has only finitely many jumps. For $3\le p<\infty$, set $γ_p=2p/(2p-3)$.
